summary: The author describes a new Meta transcription capability that uses adaptive delay for real-time word-level transcription, is trained on 70+ languages (25 validated at launch), handles mid-sentence code-switching, and supports hour-plus sessions with 20+ speakers without post-processing.

mechanisms.reason: Supporting hour-long sessions with 20+ speakers without post-processing implies sustained context/state tracking per session, though no serving architecture detail is given.
mechanisms.quote: manages hour+ sessions and 20+ speakers without post-processing

practices.reason: A concrete transcription model with stated language coverage, session length and speaker-count handling gives an engineer specific parameters to evaluate for real-time multilingual audio pipelines.
